label.name: Label
label.description: Label text displayed above or beside the input.

caption.name: Caption
caption.description: Helper text displayed below the input.

error.name: Error
error.description: Error message shown below the input; also applies danger theme.

warning.name: Warning
warning.description: Warning message shown below the input; also applies warning theme.

optional.name: Optional
optional.description: When true, appends an optional indicator to the label.

orientation.name: Orientation
orientation.description: Layout orientation of the label and input.
